scenario.topic: Pick the game modes for a community esports league

options.name: 5v5 Classic Team Deathmatch
options.upside: Supports full teams and emphasizes strategic objectives.
options.concern: Requires all players to be available for each match.

options.name: 3v3 Capture the Flag
options.upside: Smaller teams allow flexible scheduling and fast-paced matches.
options.concern: Less player involvement per match compared to larger teams.

options.name: 6-Player Free-for-All
options.upside: All participants play simultaneously without team dependency.
options.concern: Lacks team strategy and coordination elements.

options.name: 4v4 King of the Hill
options.upside: Balanced team size with focus on map control tactics.
options.concern: May require more coordination to maintain hill control.

shared_context: A community esports league with 6 participants must select game modes for the upcoming season. Each mode should accommodate all players and support competitive team play with balanced match durations.

personas.name: Maya
personas.background: Maya is a community college student who enjoys fast-paced, flexible gaming sessions.
personas.private_goal: To find game modes that fit into a busy schedule and keep matches engaging.

A.reason_for: Supports full teams and strategic objectives, which is appealing.
A.reason_against: Requires all players to be available, which can be hard with a busy schedule.

B.reason_for: Smaller teams allow flexible scheduling and fast-paced matches that fit my availability.

C.reason_for: All players participate simultaneously without team dependency, making scheduling easy.
C.reason_against: Lacks team strategy, which I enjoy somewhat.

D.reason_for: Balanced team size and tactical focus are appealing and manageable.
D.reason_against: May require more coordination, which could be challenging sometimes.

personas.name: Liam
personas.background: Liam is a software developer who values competitive, strategic gameplay with moderate time commitments.
personas.private_goal: To engage in team-based modes that balance strategy and manageable match length.

A.reason_for: Supports full teams and emphasizes objectives, which is strategic.
A.reason_against: Longer matches and full team requirement can be restrictive.

B.reason_for: Smaller teams and shorter matches allow for flexible, competitive play.

C.reason_for: Easy to schedule since all play simultaneously.
C.reason_against: Lacks team play, which I prefer.

D.reason_for: Good balance of team size and tactical gameplay.
D.reason_against: Coordination demands might be a slight drawback.

personas.name: Zoe
personas.background: Zoe is a competitive gamer who thrives on full-team strategic objectives and longer matches.
personas.private_goal: To maximize team coordination and strategic depth in the league.

A.reason_for: Supports full teams and emphasizes strategic objectives, ideal for competitive play.

B.reason_for: Smaller teams allow for faster matches and some strategy.

C.reason_for: All players participate simultaneously, which is inclusive.
C.reason_against: Lacks team strategy and coordination, which I highly value.

D.reason_for: Balanced team size with tactical focus fits my competitive style.
D.reason_against: Coordination demands could be challenging but acceptable.

personas.name: Eli
personas.background: Eli is a casual player who prefers quick, straightforward matches without heavy coordination.
personas.private_goal: To enjoy the league without complex team obligations or long matches.

A.reason_against: Requires all players present and longer matches, which I find restrictive.

B.reason_for: Smaller teams and shorter matches fit my casual play style and schedule.

C.reason_for: All players play simultaneously, making it simple and quick.
C.reason_against: Lacks team strategy, which I don't mind.

D.reason_for: Balanced team size and tactical gameplay.
D.reason_against: May require more coordination than I prefer.

personas.name: Nia
personas.background: Nia is a solo-focused gamer who enjoys individual skill challenges over team coordination.
personas.private_goal: To participate in modes that highlight personal performance and quick matches.

A.reason_for: Supports full teams and strategic objectives.
A.reason_against: Requires full team availability and longer matches, which I dislike.

B.reason_for: Smaller teams and fast matches are somewhat appealing.
B.reason_against: Less focus on individual skill than I prefer.

C.reason_for: All participants play simultaneously, emphasizing individual kills and skill.

D.reason_for: Balanced team size and tactical gameplay.
D.reason_against: Requires coordination, which I find less appealing.

personas.name: Omar
personas.background: Omar is a highly engaged esports enthusiast who values direct, competitive team play with strategic depth.
personas.private_goal: To ensure the league features modes that maximize teamwork and competitive challenge.

A.reason_for: Supports full teams and strategic objectives, perfect for competitive play.

B.reason_for: Smaller teams and faster matches offer good competition and scheduling flexibility.

C.reason_for: All players participate simultaneously, which is inclusive.
C.reason_against: Lacks team strategy and coordination, which I prioritize.

D.reason_for: Balanced team size with tactical focus suits competitive play.
D.reason_against: Coordination demands may be challenging but acceptable.
